question: Where is the Nomadic Elephant 2025 exercise held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ulaanbaatar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nomadic Elephant** is a specialized **joint military exercise** conducted annually between the **Indian Army** and the **Mongolian Armed Forces**.
 
• The **2025** edition of the exercise is scheduled to be held in **Ulaanbaatar**, which is the capital city of **Mongolia**. This follows the traditional rotation of venues between the two nations to foster mutual military understanding.
 
• The primary focus of this exercise is to enhance **interoperability** and **synergy** between the two armies while performing **Counter-Terrorism** and **Peacekeeping** operations under a **United Nations** mandate.
 
• During the exercise, troops engage in **tactical-level drills**, including **room intervention**, **reflex shooting**, and survival techniques</s
